name: trommi
description: Chat and decision cards between a person and their Claude Code sessions, end-to-end encrypted
//: test: everything that runs in this repository as it is (no hub, no connector, no browser).
test:needs-hub: the client core against a real hub (hub/server.mjs). The hub is not in this repository yet: these wait for its move and fail until then.
The browser tests (app/web/core/browser-test.mjs, tabs-test.mjs, app/web/dev/e2e.mjs, e2e-mobile.mjs) need a hub and Chromium and are run by hand.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:app && npm run test:crypto && npm run test:core
